//: Copy to appsettings.Development.json (gitignored) only to give the simulator its own VAPID pair. By default it
borrows the app's (src/NcaafPickEm.Api/appsettings.Development.json or the app's user secrets), which is what
you want: the simulator runs the reminder jobs and notification handlers in its own process, and a browser
subscription only accepts pushes signed with the pair it subscribed with. With no pair anywhere,
notifications are still logged, just not delivered.
